observations.npm: All 13 image wrapper/platform packages report MIT, exact 1.15.0 and integrity pinned; image-size/omggif have no dependencies.
observations.native: Reviewed upstream native component declarations and official licenses for image, resvg, libavif, libwebp-sys, mozjpeg-sys, lodepng, oxipng and fast_image_resize. No libvips dependency declared. Component examples are not an exact resolved Rust graph.
observations.localBinary: linux-x64-gnu native addon links only standard system runtime libraries, no dynamic libvips. This does not establish absence of statically linked components.
observations.productClosure: Repository inventory reports no shipped sharp/libvips packages and no installed shipped LGPL expressions. Uninstalled optional packages remain unjudged by the existing repository gate.
observations.development: Lockfile still contains sharp/libvips for Cloudflare miniflare development tools; neither Web nor API production dependency closure reaches them.

limits: Upstream source does not supply a tracked Cargo.lock at this release commit; representative crate versions do not prove exact transitive contents of the prebuilt native binary. No complete native binary SBOM was obtained; do not claim fully certified transitive license clearance.
Final Web/API images have not been built or inventoried.
Existing license policy/review records were not changed.
